rules.statement: Under Kandyan Law, a deed of gift given by a parent to his daughter after her marriage is revocable if there is no evidence that it was given in pursuance of a promise made before the marriage.
rules.supporting_quote: "Under Kandyan Law, if a parent donates immovable property to his daughter some time after the latter's marriage, the deed of gift is revocable if there is no evidence that was given in pursuance of a promise made before the marriage. In such a case, the mere fact that the deed states that it is given 'for and in consideration of the marriage' and 'by-way of dowry' can make no difference."
